summary: Independent Bank Corp (IBCP) filed an 8-K on June 12, 2026, announcing regulatory approvals from the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and the Michigan Department of Insurance and Financial Services for its acquisition of HCB Financial Corp, parent of Highpoint Community Bank. The definitive merger agreement was signed March 18, 2026, with terms undisclosed in this filing. The transaction remains subject to HCB shareholder approval and other closing conditions. This is a US bank merger; financial terms, premium, and advisors were not provided. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any regulatory conditions attached to approvals.
